Pane options for highcharter objects

Source: R/highcharts-api.R
hc_pane.Rd

The pane serves as a container for axes and backgrounds for circular gauges and polar charts.

Usage

hc_pane(hc, ...)

Arguments

hc

A highchart htmlwidget object.

...

Options defined in https://api.highcharts.com/highcharts/pane.

Details

When used in Highcharts.setOptions for theming, the pane must be a single object, otherwise arrays are supported.

Examples

# The start and end angles give the speedometer a 300-degree sweep.
highchart() |>
  hc_chart(type = "gauge") |>
  hc_title(text = "Speedometer") |>
  hc_pane(startAngle = -150, endAngle = 150) |>
  hc_yAxis(
    min = 0,
    max = 200,
    tickInterval = 40,
    title = list(text = "km/h")
  ) |>
  hc_add_series(
    name = "Speed",
    data = 80,
    tooltip = list(valueSuffix = " km/h")
  )
